title: C-39: a loginserver shutdown sends a maintenance notice
notes: The shutdown is requested through the documented console command after the client is admitted.
The server log and the client log are both required so a silent socket close cannot pass this scenario.

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
the login window is on the screen
the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the notice is sent to the session
the client shows the maintenance notice
steps.pattern: Server has been brought down for maintenance\. Please try again later!
